name: Penjualan Harian Outlet
description: Fase 1: penjualan POS per hari/outlet/PT/kategori/jam, metode bayar, diskon/poin, retur (uang vs poin dikembalikan), anomali rekonsiliasi poin EFN. Nilai uang tanpa pajak. Zona waktu WIB. Sumber: view efn_dwh.v_pos_* (ETL 15 menit).

cards.name: Penjualan bersih
cards.sql: SELECT sum(net_sales) AS penjualan_bersih FROM efn_dwh.v_pos_outlet_daily WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND day >= {{date_from}}]] [[AND day <= {{date_to}}]] [[AND (positionCaseInsensitive(company_name, {{company}}) > 0 OR brand = upper({{company}}))]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(store_name, {{outlet}}) > 0]]

cards.name: Jumlah order
cards.sql: SELECT sum(orders) AS jumlah_order FROM efn_dwh.v_pos_outlet_daily WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND day >= {{date_from}}]] [[AND day <= {{date_to}}]] [[AND (positionCaseInsensitive(company_name, {{company}}) > 0 OR brand = upper({{company}}))]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(store_name, {{outlet}}) > 0]]

cards.name: Rata-rata nilai belanja
cards.sql: SELECT round((sum(net_sales) + sum(refunds)) / nullIf(sum(orders), 0)) AS rata_rata_basket FROM efn_dwh.v_pos_outlet_daily WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND day >= {{date_from}}]] [[AND day <= {{date_to}}]] [[AND (positionCaseInsensitive(company_name, {{company}}) > 0 OR brand = upper({{company}}))]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(store_name, {{outlet}}) > 0]]

cards.name: Retur / refund (uang)
cards.sql: SELECT sum(refunds) AS refund FROM efn_dwh.v_pos_outlet_daily WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND day >= {{date_from}}]] [[AND day <= {{date_to}}]] [[AND (positionCaseInsensitive(company_name, {{company}}) > 0 OR brand = upper({{company}}))]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(store_name, {{outlet}}) > 0]]
cards.description: Uang yang dikembalikan ke pelanggan = barang diretur - poin EFN yang dikembalikan sebagai poin.

cards.name: Tren penjualan bersih harian per outlet
cards.sql: SELECT day, store_name, sum(net_sales) AS penjualan_bersih FROM efn_dwh.v_pos_outlet_daily WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND day >= {{date_from}}]] [[AND day <= {{date_to}}]] [[AND (positionCaseInsensitive(company_name, {{company}}) > 0 OR brand = upper({{company}}))]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(store_name, {{outlet}}) > 0]] GROUP BY day, store_name ORDER BY day

cards.name: Metode pembayaran
cards.sql: SELECT method_name AS metode, sum(amount) AS nilai FROM efn_dwh.v_pos_payment_daily WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND day >= {{date_from}}]] [[AND day <= {{date_to}}]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(company_name, {{company}}) > 0]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(store_name, {{outlet}}) > 0]] GROUP BY metode ORDER BY nilai DESC

cards.name: Penjualan per kategori
cards.sql: SELECT if(category = '', '(tanpa kategori)', category) AS kategori, sum(net_sales) AS penjualan_bersih, sum(qty_sold) AS qty_terjual FROM efn_dwh.v_pos_sales_daily WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND day >= {{date_from}}]] [[AND day <= {{date_to}}]] [[AND (positionCaseInsensitive(company_name, {{company}}) > 0 OR brand = upper({{company}}))]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(store_name, {{outlet}}) > 0]] GROUP BY kategori ORDER BY penjualan_bersih DESC LIMIT 20

cards.name: Pola jam (WIB)
cards.sql: SELECT hour AS jam, sum(orders) AS jumlah_order, sum(net_sales) AS penjualan_bersih FROM efn_dwh.v_pos_sales_hourly WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND day >= {{date_from}}]] [[AND day <= {{date_to}}]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(company_name, {{company}}) > 0]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(store_name, {{outlet}}) > 0]] GROUP BY jam ORDER BY jam

cards.name: Diskon, promo, poin EFN & refund per hari
cards.sql: SELECT day, sum(line_discount) AS diskon_baris, sum(promo_discount) AS promo, sum(points_redeemed_idr) AS poin_efn, sum(refunds) AS refund_uang, sum(points_returned_idr) AS poin_dikembalikan FROM efn_dwh.v_pos_sales_daily WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND day >= {{date_from}}]] [[AND day <= {{date_to}}]] [[AND (positionCaseInsensitive(company_name, {{company}}) > 0 OR brand = upper({{company}}))]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(store_name, {{outlet}}) > 0]] GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
cards.description: refund_uang = uang yang dikembalikan; poin_dikembalikan = nilai baris Poin EFN pada order refund (dikembalikan sebagai poin, bukan uang).

cards.name: Ringkasan outlet harian
cards.sql: SELECT day AS tanggal, company_name AS pt, store_name AS outlet, orders AS jumlah_order, refund_orders AS order_refund, gross_sales AS penjualan_kotor, discounts AS diskon_promo, points_redeemed_idr AS poin_efn, refund_goods AS refund_barang, points_returned_idr AS poin_dikembalikan, refunds AS refund_uang, net_sales AS penjualan_bersih, avg_basket AS rata_rata_basket FROM efn_dwh.v_pos_outlet_daily WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND day >= {{date_from}}]] [[AND day <= {{date_to}}]] [[AND (positionCaseInsensitive(company_name, {{company}}) > 0 OR brand = upper({{company}}))]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(store_name, {{outlet}}) > 0]] ORDER BY tanggal DESC, outlet LIMIT 500

cards.name: Kesegaran data ETL
cards.description: Heartbeat ETL (SEC-52). Data dianggap basi bila menit_sejak_sukses > 30.
cards.sql: SELECT job, last_ok_at AS sukses_terakhir_utc, minutes_since_ok AS menit_sejak_sukses, last_status AS status_terakhir, failures_24h AS gagal_24_jam FROM efn_dwh.v_etl_freshness WHERE job IN ('cycle', 'pos_outlets', 'pos_payments', 'products', 'sales_fact_pos', 'loyalty_recon') ORDER BY job

cards.name: Poin dikembalikan saat refund (Rp)
cards.description: Nilai baris Poin EFN pada order refund: bagian refund yang dikembalikan sebagai poin (restore BFF), terpisah dari refund uang.
cards.sql: SELECT sum(points_returned_idr) AS poin_dikembalikan FROM efn_dwh.v_pos_outlet_daily WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND day >= {{date_from}}]] [[AND day <= {{date_to}}]] [[AND (positionCaseInsensitive(company_name, {{company}}) > 0 OR brand = upper({{company}}))]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(store_name, {{outlet}}) > 0]]

cards.name: Barang diretur (Rp)
cards.description: Nilai barang yang diretur sebelum dikurangi poin yang dikembalikan (= refund uang + poin dikembalikan).
cards.sql: SELECT sum(refund_goods) AS refund_barang FROM efn_dwh.v_pos_outlet_daily WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND day >= {{date_from}}]] [[AND day <= {{date_to}}]] [[AND (positionCaseInsensitive(company_name, {{company}}) > 0 OR brand = upper({{company}}))]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(store_name, {{outlet}}) > 0]]

cards.name: Anomali poin EFN (rekonsiliasi terakhir)
cards.description: Rekonsiliasi harian ETL ledger poin BFF vs order POS Odoo (SEC-61). > 0 = periksa (alert critical).
cards.sql: SELECT anomalies AS anomali_kritis FROM efn_dwh.v_loyalty_recon_daily ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 1

cards.name: Antrean poin perlu review
cards.description: Outbox ditahan/gagal/tertunda dan order/reservasi berstatus review yang menua (POS manager / Finance).
cards.sql: SELECT open_items AS perlu_review FROM efn_dwh.v_loyalty_recon_daily ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 1

cards.name: Temuan rekonsiliasi poin EFN (run terakhir)
cards.description: Per jenis temuan dan PT. Sampel = id order Odoo (cari di Point of Sale > Orders). Tanpa data pelanggan.
cards.sql: SELECT run_at AS waktu_run_utc, severity AS tingkat, kind AS jenis, company_code AS pt, findings AS jumlah, arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(x -> toString(x), sample_order_ids), ', ') AS contoh_order_id FROM efn_dwh.v_loyalty_recon_latest WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND company_code = upper({{company}})]] ORDER BY tingkat, jumlah DESC LIMIT 200

cards.name: Penjualan per wilayah domisili pembeli (kab/kota)
cards.description: G21 (ADR-036 §0.7): kode wilayah Kemendagri pembeli/member saat transaksi dimuat. 'Tanpa wilayah' = order tanpa member atau member tanpa wilayah. Tanpa identitas pelanggan.
cards.sql: SELECT region_code AS kode_wilayah, region_name AS wilayah, state_name AS provinsi, sum(orders) AS jumlah_order, sum(gross_sales) AS penjualan_kotor, sum(refunds) AS refund_uang, sum(net_sales) AS penjualan_bersih FROM efn_dwh.v_pos_sales_region_daily WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND day >= {{date_from}}]] [[AND day <= {{date_to}}]] [[AND (positionCaseInsensitive(company_name, {{company}}) > 0 OR brand = upper({{company}}))]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(store_name, {{outlet}}) > 0]] GROUP BY kode_wilayah, wilayah, provinsi ORDER BY penjualan_bersih DESC LIMIT 600
